feature: DMG Synth VGM seek / audible channel state at destination

scope.transport: Async seek(seconds) keeps Play / Pause; explicit seek from Stop/EOF lands paused. Finite targets are clamped to the validated duration and rounded to the nearest audio frame.
scope.reconstruction: Fresh reference APU and parser advance silently from the start, retaining future PCM. No checkpoint cache or shared parser/WASM changes.
scope.live: All four destination snapshots refresh once even with Live Off; paused audition and Capture use that instant.
scope.controls: Range input previews only until change/release; native Arrow/Home/End navigation, Escape cancellation, progress and 390px layout.
scope.ownership: Prior trials retire; latest seek wins. Stop/source/Code/pagehide fence old work, and whenIdle waits pending mutable host preparation and candidate disposal.

exactPcm: Both seek directions and Resume match never-seeked linear playback at the same target frame.
Targets include 39689 and 39690: the Wave RAM transition at 0.9 seconds occurs at the exact recorded boundary.
Elapsed Envelope/Sweep/LFSR history matches the linear reference; naive register-only replay produces a different waveform.
Reference reconstruction does not command, borrow, advance or rewrite the separately held author APU.
additionalCoverage: Stopped/playing/paused/ended states, target zero and EOF, clamping and malformed input.
Live Off success refresh and exact frozen observation rollback after cancellation/failure.
Retained future PCM, no discarded buffers scheduled, bounded 2048-frame process slices and cooperative yields.
Delayed engine/host preparation, latest request, Stop/load/dispose cancellation, timeout and whenIdle cleanup.
Range draft/change/cancel behavior and existing Capture transaction regressions.

limits: Each seek reconstructs from the beginning without a checkpoint cache; preparation has a 30-second work deadline and restores the prior position on failure.
VGM loop repetition remains outside this change; recorded command stream is played once.
The existing single normal-clock direct-write DMG VGM subset and 16 MiB Files limit remain.
